name: Favored of Elune?
summary: Erelas Ambersky asks you to bring him Wildkin Feathers from the Hinterlands. He is waiting for them in Rut'theran Village.

sections.title: A Request from Erelas
sections.body: In Rut'theran Village, Erelas Ambersky is waiting for a collection of Wildkin Feathers. He asks you to gather fifteen from the Hinterlands and bring them to him.

faq.answer: Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village asks you to bring him Wildkin Feathers.

faq.q: Where do the Wildkin Feathers come from?
faq.answer: The Wildkin Feathers are to be collected from the Hinterlands.

faq.q: How many feathers does Erelas need?
faq.answer: Erelas asks you to collect fifteen Wildkin Feathers.

faq.q: Where should I bring the feathers?
faq.answer: Bring the Wildkin Feathers to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

attribution: In-game quest text: Favored of Elune?
